latin: Motus primi coeli, et uniuersaliter quilibet motus siue localis siue alterationis, secundario et per accidens tempore mensuratur.
translation: The motion of the first heaven, and universally any motion, whether local or of alteration, is measured by time secondarily and accidentally.
